644	def _unqual(ctype: str) -> str:
645	    return " ".join(w for w in ctype.split() if w not in _QUALIFIERS)
646	
647	
648	def _arith_kind(ctype: str) -> str | None:
649	    words = _unqual(ctype).split()
650	    if not words:
651	        return None
652	    if len(words) == 1 and _FLOAT_WORD_RE.fullmatch(words[0]):
653	        return words[0]
654	    if all(_INT_WORD_RE.fullmatch(w) for w in words):
655	        return "int"

659	def _nondet(ctype: str) -> str:
660	    return "nondet_" + re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", ctype.strip())

663	def _shape(signature: UnitSignature) -> tuple[object, ...]:
664	    index = {p.name: i for i, p in enumerate(signature.params)}
665	    parts: list[object] = [" ".join(signature.return_ctype.split())]
666	    for p in signature.params:
667	        if isinstance(p, ScalarParam):
668	            parts.append(("scalar", " ".join(p.ctype.split())))
669	        else:
670	            length = p.length.strip()
671	            parts.append(
672	                (
673	                    "buffer",
674	                    " ".join(p.elem_ctype.split()),
675	                    p.const,
676	                    p.out,
677	                    f"#{index[length]}" if length in index else length,
678	                )
679	            )
680	    return tuple(parts)

682	
683	def _signature_refusal(signature: UnitSignature) -> str | None:
684	    ret = signature.return_ctype.strip()
685	    if ret != "void" and _arith_kind(ret) is None:
686	        return f"return type `{ret}` is not void or a plain arithmetic type"
687	    by_name = {p.name: p for p in signature.params}
688	    for p in signature.params:
689	        if p.name.startswith(_PRIVATE):
690	            return f"parameter `{p.name}` uses the reserved prefix `{_PRIVATE}`"
691	        if isinstance(p, ScalarParam):
692	            if _arith_kind(p.ctype) is None:
693	                return f"parameter `{p.name}` has non-arithmetic type `{p.ctype}`"
694	            continue
695	        if _arith_kind(p.elem_ctype) is None:
696	            return (
697	                f"parameter `{p.name}` points to non-arithmetic type "
698	                f"`{p.elem_ctype}` (struct and typedef pointers are not modelled)"
699	            )
700	        length = p.length.strip()
701	        if p.out and length == "1":
702	            continue
703	        if length.isdecimal():
704	            if int(length) > _MAX_LITERAL_LEN:
705	                return (
706	                    f"buffer `{p.name}` has literal length {length} "
707	                    f"> {_MAX_LITERAL_LEN}"
708	                )
709	            continue
710	        owner = by_name.get(length)
711	        if not isinstance(owner, ScalarParam) or _arith_kind(owner.ctype) != "int":
712	            return (
713	                f"buffer `{p.name}` length `{length}` is not an integer "
714	                "parameter or decimal literal"
715	            )
716	    return None

718	
719	def _fragment_refusal(view: str, symbol: str) -> str | None:
720	    match = re.search(rf"(?<![\w.]){re.escape(symbol)}\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*\{{", view)
721	    if match is None:
722	        return f"could not locate the parameter list of `{symbol}`"
723	    for frag in match.group(1).split(","):
724	        if frag.count("*") > 1 or frag.count("[") > 1:
725	            return f"parameter `{frag.strip()}` is multi-level or multi-dimensional"
726	        if re.search(r"\b(?:struct|union|enum)\b|\.\.\.", frag):
727	            return f"parameter `{frag.strip()}` is not a plain arithmetic type"
728	    return None
729	
730	
731	def _out_param_refusal(signature: UnitSignature, body: str, label: str) -> str | None:
732	    """A single-element output must only be dereferenced.
733	
734	    `extract_signature` types a trailing non-const pointer as a one-element output;
735	    a pointer forwarded, indexed or advanced is really a buffer of unknown extent
736	    (e.g. ``msort``'s ``tmp``), so the harness would model it wrongly.
737	    """
738	    for p in signature.params:
739	        if not (isinstance(p, BufferParam) and p.out and p.length.strip() == "1"):
740	            continue
741	        n = re.escape(p.name)
742	        for use in re.finditer(rf"(?<![\w.]){n}\b", body):
743	            before = body[: use.start()].rstrip()
744	            after = body[use.end() :]
745	            allowed = (
746	                before.endswith("*")
747	                or before.endswith("!")
748	                or re.match(r"\s*\[\s*0\s*\]", after)
749	                or re.match(r"\s*[!=]=\s*(?:NULL|0)\b", after)
750	                or re.search(r"\b(?:NULL|0)\s*[!=]=$", before)
751	            )
752	            if not allowed:
753	                return (
754	                    f"{label}: output parameter `{p.name}` is used other than by "
755	                    "dereference (forwarded, indexed or advanced); its extent cannot "
756	                    "be inferred from the signature"
757	                )
758	    return None
759	
760	
761	def _prepare(reference: str, candidate: str, symbol: str) -> tuple[UnitSignature, str]:
762	    """Validate the pair and return the shared signature and the renamed reference."""
763	    views: dict[str, str] = {}
764	    scans: dict[str, _Scan] = {}
765	    sigs: dict[str, UnitSignature] = {}
766	    for label, source in (("reference", reference), ("candidate", candidate)):
767	        view = _scan_view(source)
768	        views[label] = view
769	        if re.search(r"(?<![\w.])main\s*\(", view):
770	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(f"{label} source mentions main()")
771	        scan = _scan(view)
772	        if scan.state is not None:
773	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(f"{label} source {scan.state} (v1 refuses state)")
774	        if symbol not in scan.functions:
775	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(f"{label} source does not define `{symbol}`")
776	        scans[label] = scan
777	        try:
778	            sigs[label] = extract_signature(source, symbol)
779	        except HarnessError as exc:
780	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(f"{label} signature not modelled: {exc}") from exc
781	        reason = _fragment_refusal(view, symbol) or _signature_refusal(sigs[label])
782	        if reason is not None:
783	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(f"{label}: {reason}")
784	        reason = _out_param_refusal(sigs[label], scan.functions[symbol], label)
785	        if reason is not None:
786	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(reason)
787	    if _shape(sigs["reference"]) != _shape(sigs["candidate"]):
788	        raise EquivalenceRefusal(
789	            "reference and candidate signatures differ (return type, parameter "
790	            "types, buffer roles or lengths)"
791	        )
792	    signature = sigs["candidate"]
793	    reason = renderability_reason(
794	        signature, SemanticSpec("1", result_var=f"{_PRIVATE}result")
795	    )
796	    if reason is not None:
797	        raise EquivalenceRefusal(reason)
798	    for label in ("reference", "candidate"):
799	        if re.search(rf"\w{re.escape(REFERENCE_SUFFIX)}\b", views[label]):
800	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(
801	                f"{label} source already uses a `{REFERENCE_SUFFIX}` name"
802	            )
803	    renamed = reference
804	    names = sorted(scans["reference"].functions)
805	    for name in names:
806	        renamed = rename_all_declarations_and_definitions(
807	            renamed, name, name + REFERENCE_SUFFIX
808	        )
809	    leftover = _scan_view(renamed)
810	    for name in names:
811	        if re.search(rf"(?<!\.)(?<!->)\b{re.escape(name)}\b", leftover):
812	            raise EquivalenceRefusal(
813	                f"reference refers to `{name}` other than by a direct call "
814	                "(function pointer or shadowing name); it cannot be renamed safely"
815	            )
816	    return signature, renamed

5	function it defines renamed with a ``__ref`` suffix) and the candidate in one
6	translation unit; ``main`` draws nondet inputs once, gives each version its own
7	copy of every buffer, calls both, and asserts the *relation* over the return
8	value and every non-const buffer.
9	
10	The relation is bitwise equality. Floats compare as "both NaN, or bit-identical",
11	so NaN payloads do not matter but -0.0 and +0.0 differ.

14	divergence found up to bound k and length bound ``max_len``*, never "equivalent
15	for all inputs". Every verdict carries both bounds. An inconclusive run is
16	``EquivalenceUnknown`` and a unit the harness cannot model faithfully is
17	``EquivalenceRefused`` with a reason; neither is ever read as VERIFIED.
18	
19	``filter_equivalent`` uses the check to drop mutants equal to the original. A
20	mutant that diverges only *beyond* the bound looks equivalent too and is skipped
21	with the rest, which shrinks the denominator of a kill-rate and inflates it. That
22	bias is inherent to a bounded check; it is why the skipped count is always
23	reported alongside the filter's result.
24	
25	Scope of the shared translation unit (v1, fail closed): sources that define a
26	file-scope object, a file-scope aggregate, ``main``, or function-local ``static``
27	state are refused, as are non-arithmetic parameters and mismatched signatures.
28	State hidden behind an ``#include`` is not visible to this text-level analysis.
29	"""

205	def render_equivalence_harness(
206	    *,
207	    reference_source: str,
208	    candidate_source: str,
209	    symbol: str,
210	    max_len: int = DEFAULT_MAX_LEN,
211	) -> EquivalenceHarness:
212	    """Return one C translation unit comparing `symbol` across two sources.
213	
214	    Pure string synthesis. Raises `EquivalenceRefusal` (a `HarnessError`) with a
215	    reason for anything the harness cannot model: see the module docstring.
216	    Each buffer length is capped at `max_len`; buffers and their fills are
217	    unrolled, so only loops inside the units need ``--unwind``.
218	    """
219	    if max_len < 0:
220	        raise EquivalenceRefusal(f"max_len must be >= 0, got {max_len}")
221	    signature, ref_text = _prepare(reference_source, candidate_source, symbol)
222	    scalars = [p for p in signature.params if isinstance(p, ScalarParam)]
223	    buffers = [p for p in signature.params if isinstance(p, BufferParam)]
224	    bounds = plan_length_bounds(signature, SemanticSpec("1"), max_len)
225	    returns_void = signature.return_ctype.strip() == "void"
226	    ret_ctype = _unqual(signature.return_ctype)
227	
228	    body: list[str] = []
229	    inputs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
230	    outputs: list[_Output] = []
231	    asserts: list[str] = []
232	    nondet: list[str] = []
233	    float_kinds: set[str] = set()
234	
235	    def need_nondet(ctype: str) -> None:
236	        if ctype not in nondet:
237	            nondet.append(ctype)
238	
239	    def eq(ctype: str, a: str, b: str) -> str:
240	        kind = _arith_kind(ctype)
241	        if kind in ("float", "double"):
242	            float_kinds.add(kind)
243	            return f"{_PRIVATE}same_{kind}({a}, {b})"
244	        return f"({a} == {b})"
245	
246	    for p in scalars:
247	        ctype = _unqual(p.ctype)
248	        need_nondet(ctype)
249	        body.append(f"    {ctype} {p.name} = {_nondet(ctype)}();")
250	        inputs.append((p.name, p.name))
251	    for name, bound in bounds:
252	        body.append(f"    __ESBMC_assume(({name} >= 0 && {name} <= {bound}));")
253	
254	    ref_args: dict[str, str] = {p.name: p.name for p in scalars}
255	    cand_args: dict[str, str] = dict(ref_args)
256	    for b in buffers:
257	        elem = _unqual(b.elem_ctype)
258	        need_nondet(elem)
259	        ref_name = f"{_PRIVATE}ref_{b.name}"
260	        if b.out and b.length.strip() == "1":
261	            seed = f"{_PRIVATE}in_{b.name}"
262	            body += [
263	                f"    {elem} {seed} = {_nondet(elem)}();",
264	                f"    {elem} {b.name} = {seed};",
265	                f"    {elem} {ref_name} = {seed};",
266	            ]
267	            inputs.append((b.name, seed))
268	            ref_args[b.name] = f"&{ref_name}"
269	            cand_args[b.name] = f"&{b.name}"
270	            if not b.const:
271	                ro, co = f"{_PRIVATE}out_ref_{b.name}", f"{_PRIVATE}out_{b.name}"
272	                outputs.append(_Output(b.name, ro, co))
273	                asserts += [
274	                    f"    {elem} {ro} = {ref_name};",
275	                    f"    {elem} {co} = {b.name};",
276	                    f'    __ESBMC_assert({eq(elem, ro, co)}, "{_LABEL}:{b.name}");',
277	                ]
278	            continue
279	        count = int(b.length) if b.length.strip().isdecimal() else max_len
280	        body += [
281	            f"    {elem} *{b.name} = malloc(({b.length}) * sizeof({elem}));",
282	            f"    {elem} *{ref_name} = malloc(({b.length}) * sizeof({elem}));",
283	            f"    __ESBMC_assume({b.name} != NULL);",
284	            f"    __ESBMC_assume({ref_name} != NULL);",
285	        ]
286	        for j in range(count):
287	            seed = f"{_PRIVATE}in_{b.name}_{j}"
288	            body += [
289	                f"    if (({b.length}) > {j}) {{",
290	                f"        {elem} {seed} = {_nondet(elem)}();",
291	                f"        {b.name}[{j}] = {seed};",
292	                f"        {ref_name}[{j}] = {seed};",
293	                "    }",
294	            ]
295	            inputs.append((f"{b.name}[{j}]", seed))
296	            if not b.const:
297	                label = f"{b.name}[{j}]"
298	                ro = f"{_PRIVATE}out_ref_{b.name}_{j}"
299	                co = f"{_PRIVATE}out_{b.name}_{j}"
300	                outputs.append(_Output(label, ro, co))
301	                asserts += [
302	                    f"    if (({b.length}) > {j}) {{",
303	                    f"        {elem} {ro} = {ref_name}[{j}];",
304	                    f"        {elem} {co} = {b.name}[{j}];",
305	                    f'        __ESBMC_assert({eq(elem, ro, co)}, "{_LABEL}:{label}");',
306	                    "    }",
307	                ]
308	        ref_args[b.name] = ref_name
309	        cand_args[b.name] = b.name
310	
311	    order = [p.name for p in signature.params]
312	    ref_call = f"{symbol}{REFERENCE_SUFFIX}({', '.join(ref_args[n] for n in order)})"
313	    cand_call = f"{symbol}({', '.join(cand_args[n] for n in order)})"
314	    if returns_void:
315	        body += [f"    {ref_call};", f"    {cand_call};"]
316	    else:
317	        rr, rc = f"{_PRIVATE}ret_ref", f"{_PRIVATE}ret"
318	        body += [
319	            f"    {ret_ctype} {rr} = {ref_call};",
320	            f"    {ret_ctype} {rc} = {cand_call};",
321	            f'    __ESBMC_assert({eq(ret_ctype, rr, rc)}, "{_LABEL}:return");',
322	        ]
323	        outputs.insert(0, _Output("return", rr, rc))
324	    body += asserts
325	    for b in buffers:
326	        if not (b.out and b.length.strip() == "1"):
327	            body += [f"    free({b.name});", f"    free({_PRIVATE}ref_{b.name});"]
328	
329	    lines = [f"#include <{inc}>" for inc in _INCLUDES]
330	    lines += ["", ref_text.strip("\n"), "", candidate_source.strip("\n"), ""]
331	    for kind, bits in (("float", "uint32_t"), ("double", "uint64_t")):
332	        if kind in float_kinds:
333	            lines += [
334	                f"static int {_PRIVATE}same_{kind}({kind} p, {kind} q) {{",
335	                f"    union {{ {kind} v; {bits} u; }} {_PRIVATE}x, {_PRIVATE}y;",
336	                f"    {_PRIVATE}x.v = p;",
337	                f"    {_PRIVATE}y.v = q;",
338	                f"    return (p != p && q != q) || {_PRIVATE}x.u == {_PRIVATE}y.u;",
339	                "}",
340	                "",
341	            ]
342	    lines += [f"{c} {_nondet(c)}(void);" for c in nondet]
343	    lines += ["", "int main(void) {", *body, "    return 0;", "}"]
344	    return EquivalenceHarness(
345	        source_text="\n".join(lines) + "\n",
346	        length_bounds=bounds,
347	        input_vars=tuple(inputs),
348	        outputs=tuple(outputs),
349	    )

352	def check_equivalence(
353	    *,
354	    reference: str,
355	    candidate: str,
356	    symbol: str,
357	    k: int,
358	    max_len: int = DEFAULT_MAX_LEN,
359	    timeout_s: float | None = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S,
360	    extra_flags: Sequence[str] = (),
361	    esbmc_bin: str = "esbmc",
362	    work_dir: Path | None = None,
363	    verify_port: VerifyPort | None = None,
364	) -> EquivalenceResult:
365	    """Check ``reference::symbol`` against ``candidate::symbol`` up to bound `k`.
366	
367	    Unwinding assertions are ON (an under-unwound loop is UNKNOWN, never a
368	    vacuous VERIFIED). A safety violation in the reference is a refusal (the
369	    pair's shape is not modelled faithfully); one elsewhere is UNKNOWN. `verify_port`
370	    replaces the real ESBMC port, as in ``core.check.check_source``. The harness
371	    file goes under `work_dir`, or a temporary directory removed afterwards.
372	    """
373	    try:
374	        harness = render_equivalence_harness(
375	            reference_source=reference,
376	            candidate_source=candidate,
377	            symbol=symbol,
378	            max_len=max_len,
379	        )
380	    except EquivalenceRefusal as exc:
381	        return EquivalenceRefused(str(exc))
382	    except HarnessError as exc:
383	        return EquivalenceRefused(f"signature not modelled: {exc}")
384	    port = verify_port or escalating_port(
385	        partial(
386	            verify,
387	            timeout_s=timeout_s,
388	            esbmc_bin=esbmc_bin,
389	            extra_flags=(*extra_flags, "--no-slice"),
390	            no_unwinding_assertions=False,
391	        )
392	    )
393	
394	    def run(directory: Path) -> EsbmcResult:
395	        path = directory / f"equivalence_{symbol}.c"
396	        path.write_text(harness.source_text)
397	        return port(path, unwind=k)
398	
399	    if work_dir is not None:
400	        work_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
401	        result = run(work_dir)
402	    else:
403	        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="forseti-equivalence-") as tmp:
404	            result = run(Path(tmp))
405	    return _classify(result, harness, k)
406	
407	
408	def _classify(
409	    result: EsbmcResult, harness: EquivalenceHarness, k: int
410	) -> EquivalenceResult:
411	    bounds = harness.length_bounds
412	    if isinstance(result, Verified):
413	        return EquivalenceVerified(k, bounds, result.meta)
414	    if isinstance(result, EsbmcUnknown):
415	        reason = UnknownReason[result.reason.name]
416	        return EquivalenceUnknown(k, bounds, reason, reason.value, result.meta)
417	    if isinstance(result, Error):
418	        return EquivalenceUnknown(
419	            k, bounds, UnknownReason.ERROR, result.message, result.meta
420	        )
421	    assert isinstance(result, Violated)
422	    cex = result.counterexample
423	    description = cex.violated_property.description if cex else ""
424	    if _LABEL in description or (cex is None and _LABEL in result.raw_counterexample):
425	        return EquivalenceViolated(
426	            k,
427	            bounds,
428	            _witness(cex, harness, description),
429	            result.raw_counterexample,
430	            result.meta,
431	        )
432	    function = cex.violated_property.loc.function if cex else None
433	    where = function or "unknown location"
434	    detail = f"{description or 'safety property violated'} in {where}"
435	    if function is not None and function.endswith(REFERENCE_SUFFIX):
436	        return EquivalenceRefused(
437	            "the reference itself violates a property under the harness's assumed "
438	            f"input shape ({detail}); equivalence is not decided"
439	        )
440	    return EquivalenceUnknown(k, bounds, UnknownReason.FAULT, detail, result.meta)
441	
442	
443	def _witness(
444	    cex: Counterexample | None, harness: EquivalenceHarness, description: str
445	) -> Witness:
446	    values: dict[str, WitnessValue] = {}
447	    if cex is not None:
448	        for step in cex.steps:
449	            for a in step.assignments:
450	                values[a.lhs] = WitnessValue(a.value, a.binary)
451	
452	    def pick(pairs: Sequence[tuple[str, str]]) -> tuple[tuple[str, WitnessValue], ...]:
453	        return tuple((label, values[v]) for label, v in pairs if v in values)
454	
455	    _, _, diverging = description.partition(f"{_LABEL}:")
456	    return Witness(
457	        diverging=diverging.strip(),
458	        inputs=pick(harness.input_vars),
459	        reference_output=pick([(o.label, o.ref_var) for o in harness.outputs]),
460	        candidate_output=pick([(o.label, o.cand_var) for o in harness.outputs]),
461	    )

464	class MutantLike(Protocol):
465	    """What the filter needs of a mutant: an id and the full mutated source."""
466	
467	    @property
468	    def id(self) -> str: ...
469	
470	    @property
471	    def source(self) -> str: ...

474	EquivalenceChecker = Callable[..., EquivalenceResult]

477	@dataclass(frozen=True)
478	class EquivalenceFilter[M: MutantLike]:
479	    """The outcome of `filter_equivalent`.
480	
481	    `skipped_equivalent` holds only mutants found equivalent *up to `k` and
482	    `max_len`*; a mutant diverging only beyond those bounds is in it too, which
483	    inflates a kill-rate computed over `kept`. `skipped` is always reported.
484	    Every other mutant, including UNKNOWN and refused ones, is in `kept`.
485	    `results` pairs each mutant id with its result, in input order.
486	    `original_refusal` is set when the original itself could not be modelled; then
487	    nothing is skipped.
488	    """
489	
490	    kept: tuple[M, ...]
491	    skipped_equivalent: tuple[M, ...]
492	    results: tuple[tuple[str, EquivalenceResult], ...]
493	    k: int
494	    max_len: int
495	    original_refusal: str | None = None
496	
497	    @property
498	    def skipped(self) -> int:
499	        return len(self.skipped_equivalent)
500	
501	    @property
502	    def undecided(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
503	        """Ids kept because the check was UNKNOWN or refused."""
504	        return tuple(
505	            mutant_id
506	            for mutant_id, result in self.results
507	            if isinstance(result, EquivalenceUnknown | EquivalenceRefused)
508	        )
509	
510	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
511	        return {
512	            "k": self.k,
513	            "max_len": self.max_len,
514	            "skipped": self.skipped,
515	            "skipped_equivalent": [m.id for m in self.skipped_equivalent],
516	            "kept": [m.id for m in self.kept],
517	            "undecided": list(self.undecided),
518	            "original_refusal": self.original_refusal,
519	            "verdicts": {i: r.verdict.value for i, r in self.results},
520	        }
521	
522	
523	def filter_equivalent[M: MutantLike](
524	    original: str,
525	    mutants: Sequence[M],
526	    k: int,
527	    *,
528	    symbol: str,
529	    max_len: int = DEFAULT_MAX_LEN,
530	    checker: EquivalenceChecker = check_equivalence,
531	    **check_kwargs: object,
532	) -> EquivalenceFilter[M]:
533	    """Split `mutants` into kept and skipped-as-equivalent against `original`.
534	
535	    Only a VERIFIED check skips a mutant (see `EquivalenceFilter` for the bias that
536	    implies). VIOLATED, UNKNOWN and refused mutants are kept. `check_kwargs` are
537	    forwarded to `checker` (timeout, extra flags, ESBMC binary, ...).
538	    """
539	    original_refusal: str | None = None
540	    try:
541	        _prepare(original, original, symbol)
542	    except HarnessError as exc:
543	        original_refusal = str(exc)
544	    kept: list[M] = []
545	    skipped: list[M] = []
546	    results: list[tuple[str, EquivalenceResult]] = []
547	    for mutant in mutants:
548	        result: EquivalenceResult
549	        if original_refusal is not None:
550	            result = EquivalenceRefused(f"original not modelled: {original_refusal}")
551	        else:
552	            result = checker(
553	                reference=original,
554	                candidate=mutant.source,
555	                symbol=symbol,
556	                k=k,
557	                max_len=max_len,
558	                **check_kwargs,
559	            )
560	        results.append((mutant.id, result))
561	        (skipped if isinstance(result, EquivalenceVerified) else kept).append(mutant)
562	    return EquivalenceFilter(
563	        tuple(kept), tuple(skipped), tuple(results), k, max_len, original_refusal
564	    )

567	@dataclass(frozen=True)
568	class _Scan:
569	    functions: dict[str, str]
570	    state: str | None

573	def _scan_view(source: str) -> str:
574	    view = mask_string_literals(mask_comments(source))
575	    return _DIRECTIVE_RE.sub(lambda m: re.sub(r"[^\n]", " ", m.group(0)), view)
576	
577	
578	def _function_name(head: str) -> str | None:
579	    depth = 0
580	    for i in range(len(head) - 1, -1, -1):
581	        if head[i] == ")":
582	            depth += 1
583	        elif head[i] == "(":
584	            depth -= 1
585	            if depth == 0:
586	                match = re.search(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*$", head[:i])
587	                if match is None or match.group(1) == "__attribute__":
588	                    return None
589	                return match.group(1)
590	    return None
591	
592	
593	def _statement_state(statement: str) -> str | None:
594	    text = " ".join(statement.split())
595	    if not text or re.match(r"typedef\b", text):
596	        return None
597	    is_prototype = (
598	        text.endswith(")")
599	        and "=" not in text
600	        and "__attribute__" not in text
601	        and not re.search(r"\(\s*\*", text)
602	    )
603	    if is_prototype:
604	        return None
605	    return f"declares file-scope object `{text[:60]}`"

608	def _scan(view: str) -> _Scan:
609	    functions: dict[str, str] = {}

def test_filter_skips_only_verified_mutants() -> None:
    verified = EquivalenceVerified(4, (), META)
    unknown = EquivalenceUnknown(4, (), EqUnknownReason.TIMEOUT, "timeout", META)
    refused = EquivalenceRefused("nope")
    violated_src = "int f(int x) { return x; }"
    table: dict[str, EquivalenceResult] = {

        "ref": refused,
        violated_src: EquivalenceVerified(4, (), META),
    }
    mutants = [

        FakeMutant("m2", "unk"),
        FakeMutant("m3", "ref"),
    ]
    got = filter_equivalent(
        DOUBLE,
        mutants,
        4,
        symbol="f",
        checker=scripted(table),

    assert isinstance(got, EquivalenceFilter)
    assert [m.id for m in got.skipped_equivalent] == ["m1"]
    assert got.skipped == 1
    assert [m.id for m in got.kept] == ["m2", "m3"]
    assert got.undecided == ("m2", "m3")
    assert [i for i, _ in got.results] == ["m1", "m2", "m3"]
    assert got.original_refusal is None
    report = got.to_dict()
    assert report["skipped"] == 1
    assert report["skipped_equivalent"] == ["m1"]
    assert report["undecided"] == ["m2", "m3"]
    assert report["verdicts"] == {
        "m1": "verified",
        "m2": "unknown",
